mapper.sql: COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tt.type_name ORDER BY rel.is_primary DESC, rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_type_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_type tt ON tt.id = rel.type_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id ), ''), t.type_name, m.legacy_type_name )
COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mm.media_url ORDER BY mm.sort_order SEPARATOR ',') FROM app_movie_media mm WHERE mm.movie_id = m.id AND mm.media_role = 'poster' ), m.poster_urls_csv)

COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.person_name ORDER BY rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'director' ), ''), m.director_name )

COALESCE( NULLIF(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.person_name ORDER BY rel.sort_order ASC, rel.id ASC SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'cast' ), ''), m.cast_names )
LEFT JOIN app_movie_type t ON t.id = m.movie_type_id LEFT JOIN app_movie_region r ON r.id = m.region_id

COALESCE(m.legacy_dianyingxinxi_id, m.id) AS id, m.title AS dianyingmingcheng, AS haibao, AS dianyingleixing, AS quyu, m.release_date AS shangyingshijian, AS daoyan, AS zhuyan, m.synopsis AS juqingjianjie, m.detail_html AS dianyingxiangqing, m.like_count AS thumbsupnum, m.dislike_count AS crazilynum, m.last_clicked_at AS clicktime, m.click_count AS clicknum, m.comment_count AS discussnum, m.total_score AS totalscore, m.favorite_count AS storeupnum, m.created_at AS addtime

where.if: AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_movie_type_rel filterRel INNER JOIN app_movie_type filterType ON filterType.id = filterRel.type_id WHERE filterRel.movie_id = m.id AND filterType.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{typeKeyword}, '%') ) OR t.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{typeKeyword}, '%') OR m.legacy_type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{typeKeyword}, '%') )

AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'director' AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{directorKeyword}, '%') ) OR m.director_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{directorKeyword}, '%') )

AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_movie_person_rel rel INNER JOIN app_movie_person p ON p.id = rel.person_id WHERE rel.movie_id = m.id AND rel.relation_type = 'cast' AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{castKeyword}, '%') ) OR m.cast_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{castKeyword}, '%') )
